name: Skeleton Drifter Workshop
backstory: Three weathered mechanical drifters bring agile contact, protection and heavy fire to a salvage-minded workshop. Their distinct jobs guide purchases without erasing their source chassis.
strategy_personality: Three named Skeletons bring weathered metal bodies, exposed joints, and a strong scavenged-world identity. Their different source models matter more than a common repaint; select reference views for each before assigning supported loadouts. A balanced salvage-minded roster suits their setting. Preserve Agnu's source chassis and each recruit's identity, while treating their association and arena purchasing behaviour as a design proposal.

robots.name: Burn
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.


Subject: ONE Burn, the named Skeleton recruit from Kenshi. Match the attached in-game screenshot's mechanical Skeleton head and body construction: worn dark steel narrow frame, angular broad-topped head with small round inset sensors and a long downward central face mechanism, exposed joints and ribbed mechanical torso, thin metal fingers and feet. Tattered brown cloth shoulder wrap and armoured rags, patched rag skirt over mechanical legs, all based on Kenshi salvage equipment. Hold ONE long heavy cleaver in BOTH hands lowered diagonally, no second back weapon. Preserve a weathered retired adventurer identity, no human skull or flesh. Complete full body including feet; no game UI or other characters.
Metadata only, do not render text: #186 slot 1 Burn.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Burn fills the agile contact specialist role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Sprinter tuning supports the melee equipment role; offensive stance and a 10% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Generalist strategy tuning rules with the Sprinter Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Kenshi — game continuity  
**Strategy:** Generalist · **Target roster:** 3 robots

**Proposed robots:** Burn; Sadneil; Agnu.

**Direction:** Three named Skeletons bring weathered metal bodies, exposed joints, and a strong scavenged-world identity. Their different source models matter more than a common repaint; select reference views for each before assigning supported loadouts. A balanced salvage-minded roster suits their setting. Preserve Agnu's source chassis and each recruit's identity, while treating their association and arena purchasing behaviour as a design proposal.

References: [official Kenshi game reference](https://store.steampowered.com/app/233860/Kenshi/), [secondary Skeleton model reference](https://kenshi.zone/en/skeleton).

**Production edition:** Kenshi, standard Skeleton body with arena salvage equipment; Kenshi, standard named Skeleton recruit with original arena service pistol; Kenshi, Soldierbot body with Log-Head MKII head and dark blue-grey colour identity.  
**Catalogue key:** `skeleton-drifter-workshop`
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–2; recruit slot 3 with its complete stage-0 loadout. Complete stage-1 loadouts in slot order. Refine the slot-1 lead only: verified Hone/Augment operations, then a first Sharpen at Workshop L5 and 3,000 prestige. Other slots have explicit empty refinement plans.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, repairs, upkeep, discounts and resale; stage-1 total replaces stage-0 gear and is not a simultaneous equipment inventory.
